name: The Essence of Eranikus
summary: You engage the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight, and Itharius speaks straight into your mind. Taking up the charge means helping Ysera's Dragonflight redeem the corrupted soul of Eranikus, and the first sacrifice is to give Itharius the gem that chains the part of Eranikus' mind that is still free. Itharius waits in the Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: A Voice Through the Stone
sections.body: Through the Oathstone, Itharius tells you that accepting this charge means aiding Ysera's Dragonflight to redeem the corrupted soul of Eranikus. Itharius expects many sacrifices from the two of you, and the first is to hand over the gem that has bound whatever free-willed part of Eranikus' mind remains. The Oathstone and the Chained Essence of Eranikus must go to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows, and there you choose whether to aid the dragonflight.

sections.title: A Choice Made
sections.body: Itharius greets you at yet another crossroads and asks what choice you make. Once it is made, Itharius says your choices so far have been the correct ones, and that your actions from here on will decide whether that continues.

faq.answer: Itharius speaks into your mind through the Oathstone for Ysera's Dragonflight, and waits in the Swamp of Sorrows, seeking to redeem the corrupted soul of Eranikus.

faq.q: What is the Chained Essence of Eranikus?
faq.answer: It is the gem that chains the part of Eranikus' mind that is still free. Itharius asks you to give it up as the first sacrifice.
It follows the first step of The Essence of Eranikus, under the same name.

faq.q: Where do you take the Oathstone and the essence?
faq.answer: To Itharius, in the Swamp of Sorrows, where you choose whether to aid the dragonflight.
